title: Account Manager
description:
Job Description: Senior Position Accounts Industry: Retail
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Experience: 810 Years
 Job Location: Kolkata
 Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Accounts professional from the retail industry to manage accounting operations, financial reporting, reconciliations, GST compliance, and store-wise financial transactions. The candidate should have strong knowledge of retail accounting, inventory management, vendor payments, and financial controls across multiple retail stores. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Operations Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, and general accounting. Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure timely recording of financial transactions. Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor payments, and customer-related transactions. Prepare monthly financial statements, trial balances, and account schedules. Ensure proper documentation and filing of invoices, vouchers, bills, and supporting documents. 2. Retail Store Accounting Handle accounting activities for multiple retail outlets and the corporate office. Reconcile daily sales, cash collections, card payments, UPI transactions, and other payment modes. Verify store-wise sales reports, cash deposits, and bank settlements. Monitor store expenses, petty cash, discounts, returns, refunds, and credit notes. Coordinate with Store Managers to resolve sales discrepancies and pending accounting issues. Ensure accurate accounting of inter-store transfers and store-related financial transactions. 3. GST & Statutory Compliance Manage GST-related accounting, including sales and purchase entries, input tax credit reconciliation, and GST data preparation. Coordinate GST return filing and ensure timely compliance with applicable statutory requirements. Maintain TDS records, deductions, challans, and return-related documentation. Coordinate with external consultants and auditors for statutory compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies. 4. Inventory & Vendor Reconciliation Reconcile inventory records with accounting data and investigate stock-related discrepancies. Coordinate with the Inventory, Warehouse, and Store Operations teams for stock reconciliation. Verify purchase invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and vendor statements. Reconcile vendor accounts and resolve outstanding payment differences. Monitor stock valuation, inventory adjustments, and goods transfer documentation. 5. Bank Reconciliation & Financial Controls Prepare monthly bank reconciliations and investigate unmatched transactions. Monitor cash flow, outstanding balances, and payment schedules. Verify payment requests and supporting documents before processing. Implement accounting controls to minimise errors, discrepancies, and financial irregularities. Support internal and external audits by providing the required financial records. 6. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly store-wise sales reports, expense reports, and profitability statements. Prepare financial MIS, outstanding reports, and reconciliation statements for management review. Analyse store expenses and highlight unusual variances or discrepancies. Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities. Submit accurate reports within management-defined timelines. Required Skills Strong knowledge of accounting principles and retail accounting operations. Experience in multi-store accounting and daily sales reconciliation. Knowledge of GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, and vendor management. Proficiency in Tally Prime, MS Excel, and accounting/ERP software. Strong analytical, numerical, and reconciliation skills. Good coordination and communication skills with stores, warehouse, vendors, and internal departments. Eligibility Criteria Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or relevant professional qualifications will be preferred. 8–10 years of relevant accounting experience. Mandatory: Candidates must have prior experience in the Retail Industry. Experience handling accounts for multiple retail stores or an organised retail chain is preferred. Candidates should be comfortable managing high-volume transactions and store-wise financial reporting. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates from fashion and apparel retail, lifestyle brands, footwear, departmental stores, supermarkets, or other organised retail chains will be preferred.

Key Skills: Management,Account management,Accounting,Gst,Finance

Build a career based on performance, ownership, and impactnot just years of experience. At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY- Assurance - Senior Manager As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements. The opportunity We re looking for individual who should have Assurance related experience in the Asset Management industry. connectivity between GDS team and engagement teams and leverage good connections to identify more opportunities for work Actively support the communication agenda for the Asset Management sector Support the Segment Leader in developing annual growth, resource and activity plans Monitor KPIs (growth, quality feedback, utilization, risk management compliance, attrition, etc.) for the teams under supervision and take appropriate action wherever required Manage quality of service delivery Identify sector-specific training needs, review and update current curriculum Assist in organizing and providing technical training (both Sector and Assurance methodology) Assist in addressing service delivery quality issues if and when they occur Support exceptional service delivery action programs Establish a practice of Best Practice sharing within the Asset Management Segment teams Skills and attributes for success Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards Asset Management, assurance experience with specific focus on Hedge Funds and Private Equity Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills Strong project and people management skills with experience in serving global clients Strong verbal and written communication skills in English To qualify for the role, you must have Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / CPA/ACCA) Approximately over 10 years of Assurance relevant experience with well-known CA firms. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
